scope: Analytic feasibility and instrument-budget calculations; no measured gain or qualified material
measured_source: Wang et al., Nature Communications 12,6333 (2021), DOI 10.1038/s41467-021-26705-x

budget.status: UNMEASURED instrument-design budget; no device performance claim

gap_ev.status: selected nominal point near low end of source CR1 range; not a precise same-device energy measurement

slope_per_ev.status: derivative of published MLJ fit at fixed coupling and reorganization; field-slope transfer unverified

density_m3.status: design concentration target, not source measurement

effective_dipole_Cm.status: required measurable target; not established for CdS-AZ in the proposed cell

thickness_m.status: proposed active thickness; extra interfaces omitted from this ideal budget

relative_background_permittivity.status: design assumption, must measure at RF under illumination

rotation.status: ideal comparison; actual orientation persistence not acquired
